gloss: to stifle; to suppress; to bite back

definitions.gloss: to stifle; to suppress (a yawn, laugh, or impulse)
definitions.explanation: To suppress or hold back a physical or emotional response, especially a yawn or laugh. The image is of biting something to stop it from escaping.

examples.japanese: あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す。
⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}して⟦{真剣|しんけん}→真剣：01565_shinken⟧な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I suppressed a laugh and kept a serious face.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧な⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}さなければ⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During the boring meeting, I had to stifle yawns many times.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧ (to bite) + ⟦{殺|ころ}す→殺す：01944_korosu⟧ (to kill/suppress). Used figuratively to mean holding back an involuntary response.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- あくび⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す: to stifle a yawn
- ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す: to suppress a laugh
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噛|か}み{殺|ころ}す: to suppress anger

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to hold back, to suppress — more general; can apply to emotions or physical actions
- ⟦{堪|こら}える→堪える：08995_koraeru⟧: to endure, to hold back — implies effort; used for tears, laughter, pain
